prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one photorealistic premium 3D studio catalogue render based on this reference assortment of PRINTED pharmaceutical outer paperboard cartons. The image must look like fully printed pharmaceutical packaging, not blank cartons or simple abstract mockups: red/white, plum/white, blue/white and orange/white colour blocking, professional typographic hierarchy, restrained thin rules, tiny neutral sample-copy lines, small barcode-style graphics on side panels. Use only generic readable text such as "SAMPLE", "PHARMACEUTICAL CARTON", "CUSTOM PRINT" and "PACKAGING SAMPLE"; do not reproduce real brands, drug names, ingredients, strengths, doses or certification claims from the reference. No contents or medicines. Folded smooth paperboard texture, crisp tuck seams and edges, realistic soft contact shadows, consistent soft studio lighting, warm off-white seamless backdrop matching a premium packaging website. Centered balanced three-quarter view slightly above, square composition, generous margins, no cropped cartons, no external text or watermark.
